Reviewed the changed event-delivery functions against the described EventBus/SSE boundaries. EventBus remains synchronous and ephemeral; per-subscriber read checks remain live and queued frames recheck access. Canonical session and SDK references now own the numeric bounds and default watchdog. Existing broader architecture claims are unchanged; no physical/provider qualification is inferred.
